note: November 2026 — handwritten for the US news. Only sent if this month matches; December writes itself.
subject: 🐸 The frogs can cross the Atlantic now
heading: From the pond this month
body_html:
Hello. A short one this month, with one bit of real news.

Frog Logic now posts properly to the US. About half the people who visit the shop are in America, and until now the only thing they could really buy was a download — sending a tee across the Atlantic cost more than the tee. So I found US printers. Tees, mugs, prints and notebooks are now made and posted inside the US: no Atlantic postage, and no import charge on the doorstep. Choose the United States in the basket and the postage shows before you pay.

If you've got a friend over there who'd like something from the pond, this is the moment to send them the link.

Still yours, because you signed up: POND10 takes 10% off your first order. It works on US orders too.

One small apology: if September's note landed in your inbox twice, that was a glitch on my side, and it's fixed.

That's the lot. Go gently.
